Vendored for the browser shell (docs/dash-tasks.md §5); the board's CSP is
`script-src 'self'` and the tailnet may have no internet, so no CDN.

- `xterm.js`, `xterm.css`: @xterm/xterm 6.0.0 (MIT, `LICENSE.xterm`)
- `addon-fit.js`: @xterm/addon-fit 0.11.0 (MIT, same authors)

To update: download the npm tarballs and copy `lib/xterm.js`,
`css/xterm.css` and `lib/addon-fit.js` here.
